cards.text: This is a psalm of David, written for the choirmaster. David opens with what he calls his voice of complaint, and friend, this is NOT a complaint about a slow oven. He's asking God to hear him and to keep his life safe from the dread of the enemy.

cards.question: David's enemy isn't one guy. It's a whole mob of workers of iniquity. What does David ask God to do about them?

answers.text: Give him an army to fight them
Make them forget all about him

cards.text: Now David describes this mob's weapons, and whew, friend, they keep them SHARP.

cards.question: David says the mob sharpens their ___ like swords and aims their bitter words like arrows.

cards.text: And they don't fight fair. They ambush the innocent from hiding, like somebody firing off a mean text from across town so nobody even sees whose thumbs did it.

cards.question: The mob goes after the innocent, ambushing them from somewhere hidden. How does David say they shoot?

cards.text: And they don't let go. David says they hold fast to their evil purpose, and they talk about hiding their snares.

cards.question: The wicked are talking about hiding their snares. What question do they ask about them?

answers.text: Who will help us hide them

cards.text: They devise injustice, then step back and size up their plan, the way I stand at the oven window staring at a fresh batch for TEN straight minutes like it owes me money.

cards.question: The wicked admit their secret plan still has a few holes in it. True or false?

cards.text: They say, “We have perfected a secret plan.” Then comes this line: “For the inner man and the heart are mysterious.”

cards.question: Then the psalm turns, and David says he'll grab a bow and shoot back at the wicked himself. True or false?
David says God will shoot the wicked with arrows, and they will be wounded ___.

cards.text: That's the same word David used for how they shot at the innocent: suddenly. The surprise-attack crew is the one getting surprised, and I bet NOBODY in that mob saw it coming.

cards.question: Remember the mob's tongues, sharpened like swords? What will happen to those tongues?

answers.text: They'll be taught to praise God
They'll be kept quiet for good

cards.text: They will be made to stumble, and all who see will shake their heads. Friend, that's the same head shake I get when I drop a whole tray of cookies on the floor.

cards.question: Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the ___ of God.

cards.text: And they'll ponder what He has done, like folks crowded around the oven window going, “Wait. How did THAT happen?”

cards.question: David started this psalm asking God to hide him. How does he end it for the righteous?

answers.text: Rejoice and take refuge in the LORD
Keep quiet and wait for the LORD to act
Fight back in the name of the LORD

cards.text: And David finishes: “let all the upright in heart exult.” Friend, I'm hopping up and down on my gold base over here, and that thing is NOT light.
